title: Beef and cabbage braise
summary: Beef and cabbage braise is a british dinner built around lean stewing beef and white cabbage, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Warm the oil and soften the onion for Beef and cabbage braise. Stir in the garlic, ginger and spices until they smell fragrant.
steps.tip: If the spices look dusty, give them a minute in the oil before any liquid goes in.

steps.instruction: Add lean stewing beef and cook until it loses its raw look. Pour in the tomatoes or coconut and white cabbage.
Simmer gently, lid ajar, until onions is tender and the sauce coats a spoon. Add a splash of water if it sticks.
steps.tip: Taste Beef and cabbage braise before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Taste for salt and acid, then rest the pan for a couple of minutes before serving Beef and cabbage braise.
